description: Type the 400s PATCH /applications/@me (and /applications/{id}) answers when a field is refused. Discord sends a signed PING to a new `interactions_endpoint_url` or `event_webhooks_url` and refuses the update when the URL doesn't answer it: `{ code: 50035, message: "Invalid Form Body", errors: { interactions_endpoint_url: { _errors: [{ code: "APPLICATION_INTERACTIONS_ENDPOINT_URL_INVALID", message: "The specified interactions endpoint url could not be verified." }] } } }` (https://discord.com/developers/docs/interactions/overview#setting-up-an-endpoint). `InteractionsEndpointUnverified` is that case; `InvalidFormBody` (JSON code 50035, https://discord.com/developers/docs/topics/opcodes-and-status-codes#json-json-error-codes) is every other refused field. Alchemy retries the first while a just-deployed endpoint starts serving; the Discord InteractionsEndpoint and EventWebhook live suites exercise it.
